scope: Two-axis agent source review of corrected audit deployment and evidence sealing; not a human member ACK

findings.issue: Sealing trusted prior PASS without rechecking files against audited hashes
findings.resolution: Union original evidence, audited input/checker and completed audit-output inventories; reject conflicting hashes; verify before mkdir, during copies and before manifest
findings.review_status: closed by Standards and Spec reviewers

findings.issue: Audit output .log/.exit conflicts were not rejected before deployment
findings.resolution: Check receipt, log, exit and output directory before deploying; preload environment

findings.issue: Deployment wrapper itself lacked execution-time source identity
findings.resolution: Record wrapper path and SHA, verify after audit, bind same SHA during sealing

findings.issue: Prepared ZIP could be copied under a new hash without matching its earlier verification receipt
findings.resolution: Require v4 archive status, fixed verified SHA and byte length; include ZIP in audited inventory
findings.review_status: closed by Standards and Spec reviewers

review_conclusion: No remaining actionable issues identified in these prepared scripts
execution_status: Not an execution verdict; actual full campaign, corrected offline audit, cleanup and sealing remain separately evidenced
artifact_scope: Audit evidence and selected input archive, not a portable complete rebuild environment
